steps: Confirm the denial event cites policy#catalog.4.2 (RULE-CAT-04) and that the requested model is not in the user's allowlist.
Tell the user that the model is not available for their role under policy clause catalog 4.2.
Offer an alternative model that is in the user's allowlist for the current task.
If the model is required for coursework, ask the course instructor to file an allowlist exception request with the platform owner.
Record the request reference in the help-desk ticket and close it only after the platform owner answers.
safety_warnings: Never change an allowlist or a credential yourself; only the platform owner applies policy changes.
